title: Kunagalu Betta Dawn Ride
tagline: Bangalore → Bidadi → Ramanagara → Kunagalu Betta (sunrise trek through a bat cave) → Revanasiddeshwara Betta → Harohalli → Bangalore. ~135 km, out before dawn, back for lunch.
summary: A pre-dawn sprint down Mysore Road to Ramanagara, then a left onto the Kanakapura road to Kunagalu Betta — a granite hillock 2 km out of town with an ancient Nandi halfway up, a pitch-black cave you crawl through with a torch, and a Hanuman temple on the summit. Thirty minutes up, sunrise over the Sholay boulders, thirty minutes down. The return avoids the highway entirely: Revanasiddeshwara's monolith temple, then village roads across to Harohalli and the Kanakapura road home.

credit.note: 'Kunagalu Betta ride — unexpected' — a night ride out of Bangalore to the hill

segments.note: Empty at 4:30 AM. Fuel at the Bidadi pumps if the tank is low.
Boulders start to loom out of the dark on both sides.

segments.road: Ramanagara – Kanakapura road, left to Kunagalu
segments.note: Park at the base of the hillock. Muddy trail to the Nandi, then the cave, then the summit — 30 min up.
Monolith hill with the cave temple; motorable road most of the way, a few steps to the shrine.
Single-lane roads through farmland — this is the bit worth the detour. Navigate by map; some stretches are broken.
Wide and quick. Breakfast at one of the Kanakapura Road dhabas.

highlights: Sunrise from the Hanuman temple on Kunagalu Betta, with Ramadevara Betta and the whole boulder field lit up gold.
The cave stretch — cold, dark, smells of bats, and drops you out just below the summit.
Revanasiddeshwara Betta's cave shrine on a single monolith, usually empty at 8 AM.
The village road across to Harohalli instead of the highway back through Ramanagara.

offroad.summary: Tarmac with a muddy trek. The only riding challenge is the broken village road between Revanasiddeshwara and Harohalli.
notes: Kunagalu trail is loose soil and rock — fine in trainers, miserable in riding boots. Swap at the bike.
Bring a proper torch for the cave; a phone light is not enough and the floor is uneven.
The Revanasiddeshwara–Harohalli road has potholes and cattle at every village; keep it under 50.

timings: No entry fee or permit; park at the base of Kunagalu Betta. Trailhead is unmarked — locals will point.
Leave Bangalore by 4:30 AM to be on the summit for a 6:15 sunrise.
Fuel: Bidadi, Ramanagara, Harohalli. Nothing needed in between.
cautions: Riding NH 275 in the dark: watch for trucks stopped on the shoulder without lights.
The cave section is not for anyone claustrophobic; there's a walk-around.
Summer (Mar–May) makes the bare granite brutal by 9 AM — be off the hill by then.
